verdict.rationale: Vapi has a dedicated first-party documentation page for background speech denoising under assistant conversation-behavior settings. It states that the feature filters out unwanted sounds while users speak, which directly matches the noise-suppression story. missing for 10: configuration details showing how to enable or tune it, evidence it handles real-world call noise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls

citations.quote: Background speech denoising helps create clearer conversations by filtering out unwanted sounds while users speak.
